logical_target.meaning: All strong 13-vertex quotient tournaments with one fibre of size 4 and twelve singleton fibres.

final_semantic_refinement.scope: Exactly h13_p00_a000_z02, the sole open slice from the initial cube run.

logical_conclusion.proved_by_computation: The complete h13_p00 weight pattern (4,1^12) is infeasible.
logical_conclusion.module_consequence: A K16 Pisa tournament has no module of size 4.
logical_conclusion.combined_consequence: Together with the exact h<=10 audit/formal closures and h11_p00/h12_p00 closures, every module of size at least 4 is excluded. Any remaining decomposable K16 witness can use only modules of sizes 2 and 3.
